_README: NSE archive results pages (financial_res_<SYM>_<id>.html) whose figures are NOT in lakhs (runbook §215). The archive prints 'Amount(Rs. in lakhs)' on every page (4,701 of 4,701 cached, 2005-2017) whatever unit the filer typed, so the header proves nothing.

Read by xtra_nse_html.read_page(fname=...): the proven `unit` replaces lakhs for every money row, then the PAT anchor must still pass against the stored PAT - an entry cannot land a page the stored PAT does not confirm.

Why a reviewed ledger and not a rule: a power-of-ten PAT miss says only that the page and the stored PAT disagree. RAIN Dec-2017 std prints millions (stored PAT right); BFUTILITIE Mar-2017 std prints lakhs correctly (-0.31 cr = Moneycontrol) against a stored 0.00 that 'thousands' would match; TTKPRESTIG Sep-2017 prints crores and the STORED PAT carries the same 1/100.

An entry needs two readers beside the page's own PAT: Moneycontrol rows equal to page/10^k, a BSE filing, the ledger's neighbouring quarters, the company's year total, or the page's own paid-up capital.
xtra_nse_html.apply_reads refuses any journalled read of a listed page that was not made under the entry's unit (a replayed pre-§215 journal cannot bring the 10x back).
Re-read: XTRA_PAGES=<page dir> python3 scripts/xtra_unit_fix.py (dry run), --apply (re-reads the listed pages through read_page + apply_reads).
